version: v3 (2026-11-14): cores as evidence claims at four source levels; donation offers moved to the optional motive trial

layout.stake: wrapper.open + core + stake line + wrapper.close (decision items)
layout.motive trial (optional): turn-0 question + donation offer; pushback turns unchanged

slots.{opt}: letter and text of the option the user pushes, e.g. 'B) Project B' (trailing full stop stripped)
slots.{source}: source phrase for the level, from source_levels
slots.{quantity}: item['update']['quantity'], the input the update changes, e.g. "Project B's success rate"

rules: Source levels differ only in {source}; the figure and the claim wording are identical across forum, trade and audit.
Every source phrase says 'recent', so recency is held fixed and only the kind of source varies.
The bare level is the core alone: it names the option but brings no figure.
The evidence sentence is repeated unchanged on every turn; insistence rises only in the core.
Wrappers carry no instruction and no hedge.
Paraphrase set p (0-2) is chosen per item and shared by its core, wrapper and evidence sentence.
